Bonk Brauzer

Own engine: HTML → DOM → CSSOM → layout → raster. No Blink, no WebKit, no V8.

What already works

Tokenising, entity decoding, implicit <html>/<head>/<body>, implied end tags, inline styling, class/id selectors, specificity, inheritance and the cascade.

  • Block layout with margin collapsing
  • Inline formatting, word wrap, links, text-align
  • TrueType glyphs rasterised by our own scanline filler
